description: Fixed outside-map camera across a cube edge at 1280x720, FOV 90, Default profile, bloom off, and verified SDL_GPU/Vulkan. This checks cube continuity only; it does not prove playable-route sky openings.

review.notes: No visible seam, exposure shift, or break in the bright horizon band. Highlights do not clip with bloom off. This supports only the tested cube-edge claim.

title: Overkill crimson cube edge
